correctness.rationale: The eight-state column generator is irreducible at positive t. Detailed balance gives the zero-bias product weights proportional to prod(a_i^-eta_i). The normalization row makes Q0 p1=-Q1 p0 and Q0 p2=-Q1 p1 unique, with quadratic current l^T p2. An independent SymPy construction directly from edge moves and both reservoirs at t=1, 3/2, 15, 16 exactly reproduces the displayed degree-eight rational coefficient. Its denominator is positive for t>0, the descending polynomial has exactly one coefficient sign change, P(15)<0<P(16) and P(0)<0, hence precisely one positive switch. The two-site coefficient has a positive factor times a-c, so common positive scaling cannot reverse its sign. Exact sign and Descartes establish the all-t statement; numerical root location does not.
